title: nmea0183: Add VLW sentence dissector
description:
Add sentence dissector for VLW messages.

* It uses the existing dissector for the fields.
* Report incorrect fixed text
* Report an expected but missing field

### Tested

This pcap contains valid and invalid variants of VLW sentence: [nmea-test-messages.pcapng](/uploads/cacaab726ebf46addc2feb73118c71f0/nmea-test-messages.pcapng)

I have run 500 iterations of `fuzz-test.sh` with that capture.
